name: Single Temporary Residence and Work Permit (Employment)

requirements.blocker_text: A draft employment contract, or another contract by which the foreign national exercises employment rights, is required.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an employment contract with a Serbian employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of qualifications relevant to the contracted role is required.
An excerpt confirming the employer's registration in Serbia is required.

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years (issued for the contract period, up to a 36-month maximum), renewable
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: continuous residence for permanent residence allows multiple absences up to 10 months total, or one absence up to 6 months, within the 3 years

sources.title: Serbian Ministry of Interior (MUP) -- employment-based temporary residence grounds: employment contract, qualifications proof, employer registration excerpt; single permit (electronic-only) combines residence and work authorization

Welcome to Serbia (official government portal) -- unified Single Temporary Residence and Work Permit issued for up to 36 months when employment is the basis of stay; Visa D route for stays under 180 days; short-term (up to 90 days) work exemptions for specific professional categories

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the permit is tied to the specific employer/contract that founded the application; a change of employer generally requires a new application. No labour-market test (equivalent to a vacancy-advertising or local-candidate-priority requirement) was found described on either tier-1 source for the general single-permit route -- unlike, for example, Morocco's ANAPEC certificate requirement built earlier in this dataset. pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months reuse rs_permanent_residence.json's and rs_naturalisation.json's general 3-year figures since no work-specific fast-track was found.
